title: The EmDash Base release scanner accepts explicitly classified decorative chart caps while still refusing an unresolved real hardcoded role
steps: S1: Run the release role scan on the committed EmDash Base source containing its decorative HeroOd chart.
S2: Run the existing hardcoded-role fixture through the same release CLI.
expect: S1: The report matches the template version and has zero unresolved roles.
S2: The release fails and identifies the hardcoded role by file and line.
evidence: Release #1622 CI run 39893172612 failed VARS-1 at HeroOd.astro:63 on 3c0dc0f5d0. The local suite also failed before the annotation and passed all three tests afterwards.
fence: Static repository release scanner, not browser or published-quickstart acceptance. The annotation compiles to byte-identical minified Astro output. The shared scanner and real-role rejection remain unchanged.

tests: the theme as committed scans clean: the report carries this version, 0 unresolved
a hardcoded role in the shipped source stops the release and names file:line
